scope: Actual private Azure Container Apps replica; token read from process.env without disclosure

message.content:
The historical source returned was [“Britannica page 1614” in the National Library of Scotland dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/NationalLibraryOfScotland/encyclopaedia_britannica_illustrated/tree/309f765b1ecc83e0a7f7762e44b4a927a7555443), an OCR page of “THO” entries—not an astronomy article.  
The modern source selected on retry was Wikipedia’s [“Cultural astronomy”](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=1298337464), about astronomy’s roles in cultures rather than general astronomy; the initial query instead returned the unrelated “Duplicate content.”  
Both searches were partial: query and document embedding stages failed with HTTP 503, leaving lexical matching only, so these mismatched sources do not support a historical–modern comparison of astronomy.

arguments.query: astronomy: retrieve original historical Encyclopaedia Britannica astronomy article and modern Wikipedia Astronomy article; provide actual source titles, URLs, and retrieval stage availability or source mismatches

acquisition.method: az containerapp exec interactive /bin/sh on explicitly selected ready revision and replica; local HTTP request inside container; read-only SQLite transcript inspection
